title: Iraqi insurgency (2003–2011)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Iraqi insurgency (2003–2011)", at revision 1375582804, opens: "The Iraqi insurgency lasted from 2003 until 2011, beginning shortly after the 2003 American invasion deposed longtime leader Saddam Hussein, and lasting until the end of the Iraq War and U.S. withdrawal in 2011. It was followed by a renewed insurgency." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q926905, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "ongoing warfare in mainly central Iraq, which began after the 2003 invasion of Iraq". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
